title: Design Tokens
tagline: A design system generator that produces multi-platform token packages
description: Built a tool that takes a single source of truth for design tokens and generates platform-specific packages for web, iOS, Android, and Figma.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content: Design systems struggle with token synchronization across platforms. Colors, spacing, and typography values drift between Figma, web CSS, iOS SwiftUI, and Android Compose — leading to inconsistency and manual sync work.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.content: A multi-platform product is only as good as its visual consistency. When design tokens drift, the brand fragments. Automating token distribution eliminates an entire class of inconsistency bugs.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.content: A CLI tool + GitHub Action that reads a single YAML token file and generates platform-optimized output: CSS custom properties, Tailwind config, Swift enum, Compose object, and a Figma JSON plugin format.

slides.title: Technical Architecture
slides.content: The core is a composable pipeline: parse → transform → generate. Token definitions in YAML are parsed into an AST, transformed through platform-specific mutators (e.g., camelCase for Swift, kebab-case for CSS), and rendered via Handlebars templates.

slides.title: Results & Impact
slides.content: Reduced token sync time from 2 hours to instant. Used across 5 products in 2 companies. Open-source release with 600+ stars and 15 contributors.

slides.title: Learnings
slides.content: The AST approach was over-abstracted — a simpler JSON-to-target mapping would have covered 90% of use cases. Component-specific tokens (vs. global) would better serve real design system needs.
